Emergency department visit

Provider: Harborview Medical Center
Patient: Morgan Ellis
Event: Emergency department visit




  Summary: Patient reported neck stiffness and right shoulder pain after a rear-end collision.




Findings: Exam noted cervical paraspinal tenderness. Shoulder range of motion was limited by pain.
